verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of a source repository or open-source license. The published OpenAPI spec, REST API docs and MCP server describe an API surface, not readable product source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
